briefs.current_title: 基石资管梁：AI是创造就业的工具，软件公司不会消亡，Salesforce仅10倍市盈率
current_title_lines: 软件公司不会消亡，Salesforce仅10倍市盈率

subtitles.zh: 现在不了。一开始我们也不知道AI会如何发展，但现在我们越来越多地在公司工作流中实施AI。
subtitles.en: Not anymore at the beginning yes we have no idea how the AI going to work out but now I increasingly I try to implement we try to implement AI into our own workflow in our company.

subtitles.zh: 你需要专家。实际上AI在我们看来是一个很好的工具，它在创造就业。
subtitles.en: You need someone you need specialists I mean AI actually in our opinion is a great tool actually creating jobs.

subtitles.zh: 所以软件公司不会完全放弃商业模式，其他人会有更多AI，但中间需要专家。
subtitles.en: So for software companies to totally give up their business model everyone else going to have more braze AI you need someone expert specialist in between.

subtitles.zh: 我认为软件在整个生态中确实有作用，比如CRM，Salesforce，市盈率只有10倍。
subtitles.en: I think software do have a role in to play in that whole ecosystem in for example you know like the CRM right Salesforce right shooting at 10 times earnings.

subtitles.zh: 我认为如果他们用AI工具进行适当转型，并被客户企业使用，那将是很好的业务。
subtitles.en: I think if they make a proper transition using AI tools for their software business and used by the customers the corporations I think will be great business.

subtitles.zh: 回到中国科技，看腾讯的定价，感觉他们更优先市场份额而非利润。
subtitles.en: Michael just bring it back to China tech as well I mean when we look at the ecosystem even with Tencent and it's token pricing you do get the sense that they are prioritizing market share more than profits.

subtitles.zh: 你在该领域看到了什么？也许因为估值，现在是介入的好时机？
subtitles.en: What are you seeing out there in the space that you know maybe because of valuations it looks right as a time to dip in.

subtitles.zh: 我认为营收增长非常重要，因为整体经济增速不如以前，所以作为成长型公司，营收增长是首要任务。
subtitles.en: If I mean growing revenue top it is very important because overall you know the Chinese economy is not growing as fast as before so as a growth company they have to you know grow the revenue probably the first and foremost.

briefs.current_title: 潘功胜：香港国际金融中心优势独特，连接内地与全球
current_title_lines: 香港国际金融中心优势独特

subtitles.zh: 通过共同努力，这些政策已经落地，助力香港发展成为更完善的金融中心。
subtitles.en: With our joint efforts, those policies are already in place and helping Hong Kong to develop into a better financial hub.

subtitles.zh: 展望未来，香港正努力成为更繁荣、更高水平的国际金融中心。
subtitles.en: Looking ahead for the future, Hong Kong is striving to be a better international financial hub with better prosperity and a higher region.

subtitles.zh: 香港商业开放繁荣，基础设施现代化，法律体系完善，货币与监管达到国际水平。
subtitles.en: Hong Kong is open and prosperous in business. The infrastructure here is modern, legal system is complete and the monetary and regulatory are international level.

subtitles.zh: 大量人才汇聚于此，支撑起金融业多元化、完整的生态系统。
subtitles.en: We have a lot of the talent gathering here which supports the diversified complete ecosystem for the financial industry.

subtitles.zh: 此外，香港毗邻内地，这是一大优势。我们面临诸多不确定性，市场资本正在分散配置。
subtitles.en: In addition, Hong Kong is adjacent to the mainland China, it is a strength. We are facing a lot of uncertainty, capital of the market are diversifying the allocation of investment.

subtitles.zh: 他们在权衡效率与监管的平衡。香港将海外市场与内地紧密连接。
subtitles.en: They are tracking the balance of efficiency and regulatory regressness. Hong Kong connects the overseas market with the mainland once.

subtitles.zh: 香港享有内地政策带来的稳定，也受益于人民币国际化带来的开放。
subtitles.en: Hong Kong enjoys stability anchored by the mainland policy. Also enjoys the openness endorsed by the internationalization of RMB.

subtitles.zh: 中国作为全球经济的核心引擎，内地经济也是香港发展的重要支撑。
subtitles.en: China as a central driver for the global economy, China's mainland economy is also a supporting foundation for Hong Kong's development.

subtitles.zh: 两周前，李强总理在峰会上指出，中国发展的稳定取决于两个因素：一是稳定环境，二是新渠道。
subtitles.en: Two weeks ago, Premier Li Qian, speech at the summit, that the stability of China's development is depending on two factors, first, the stable environment, second, the new channels.

subtitles.zh: 科技创新是中国发展的长期战略。中国拥有巨大市场、完整价值链、高速发展的科技和庞大人才库。
subtitles.en: Technology innovation is the long-term strategy for China's development. China has the huge market and the complete value chain and high-speed development of technology and the large pool of talents.
